text:
Maya: heads-up — during the Acme onboarding we started seeing webhook rejects from their Splunk ingest. Root cause looks like missing tenant tags + absent KMS envelope headers. They fail our schema strict-mode and Splunk mapping. Can we triage quick?

Jonah: saw the alert. sample error from their side: "missing required field: tenant.tags" and Splunk complains about null for `tenant_id` in the props mapping.

Maya: logging bits: we delivered payload with Content-Type: application/json but no X-Redwood-KMS-KeyId header (we normally include for envelope encryption). They use an ingestion transform that expects `tenant.tags` as an array on root.

Alice: quick question — did the recent RBAC cleanup remove `actor.role` from some system-token events? I remember a change that collapsed `actor` shape for internal calls.

Devon: yep, PR #488 removed `actor.role` for service principals unless explicitly provided. Some upstream callers never set role, so our validator fails where it requires actor.role.

Maya: ok — two related problems: (1) schema consumers expect fields we sometimes omit, (2) delivery headers for KMS envelope rotation missing on certain flows. Need short-term customer fix + longer-term schema strategy.

Jonah: short-term options: 1) webhook-shim that enriches event (add tenant.tags from routing metadata, add X-Redwood-KMS-KeyId header) 2) Splunk-side transform to pull tags from `meta` blob 3) lax validator for older customers.

Alice: leaning to #1 (shim) + #3 for a fallback. Shim buys time and keeps Splunk mapping stable. We should avoid changing customer ingestion transforms if possible.

Devon: agree. shim would be a small lambda-like adapter we insert in front of the webhook endpoint for impacted customers. It can: add `actor.role` if missing (derive from token->role map), populate `tenant.tags` from tenant service, and inject KMS envelope header if we have key_id in tenant config.

Maya: that sounds good. follow-up: do we need a formal schema bump for this? we'll need to codify `actor.role` as optional vs required and version the change.

Jonah: propose bump to schema v1.3 with a compatibility section stating: `actor.role` optional, `tenant.tags` recommended, delivery header `X-Redwood-KMS-KeyId` required for envelope-enabled tenants. Old receivers can opt into strict-mode.

Alice: I'll draft the spec update. Also the onboarding checklist should include: "verify KMS envelope header on test webhook", "validate Splunk mapping with sample event v1.3" and a small curl snippet.

Maya: can someone paste a minimal failing payload so I can repro locally?

Jonah: here you go:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_abc123",
  "actor": { "id": "svc-42", "ip": "10.1.2.3" },
  "tenant_id": "acme-9000",
  "payload": { "action": "login" }
}
```
This is missing `actor.role` and `tenant.tags` and there's no KMS header in the HTTP request.

Devon: ok reproduced. shim should add `actor.role": "service"` by default for service principals. For user tokens we keep role if present.

Alice: Security note — if shim injects KMS header we must ensure the key id is tenant-owned and logged. Don't leak other tenants' key ids. Add an audit event when shim enriches headers.

SecBot: automated-check: schema-compat-v1.2 -> target acme-9000 returned 3 warnings (missing tenant.tags, missing actor.role, missing kms_header). See /infra/schemacheck/2109998888.

Maya: action items: Jonah -> build webhook shim and integration test (due EOD sprint-1). Alice -> draft schema v1.3 and onboarding checklist + curl examples. Devon -> add unit tests for RBAC change and ensure token metadata lookup is available in delivery path. I'll coordinate with support to notify Acme and enable shim.

Jonah: quick implementation note — shim will be a small service behind feature flag per-customer. It will pull tenant metadata from tenant-service (cached) and sign an audit event to `audit.events` topic when enrichment happens.

Alice: tests: add an e2e that posts to shim -> our webhook -> Splunk ingest simulator with and without X-Redwood-KMS-KeyId and verify mapping. I'll add to onboarding CI.

Maya: one more: we should add a `schema_version` HTTP header on webhooks going forward so receivers can choose compatibility behavior. -> agreed?

Devon: agreed. header name `X-Redwood-Audit-Schema` with value `1.3`. shim should set it if older.

Maya: great. I'll send a short note to #customer-success and ping Acme. Marking this resolved for now, we have owners. :thumbsup:

Jonah: :shipit:
